recipient.description: The recipient email address to send the benchmark ping to.

server.description: The SMTP server to connect to. If empty, MX lookup is performed on the recipient domain.

port.description: The TCP port to use for the SMTP connection.

wait.description: Time in milliseconds to wait between pings.

count.description: Number of pings to send. Use 'unlimited' or a positive integer.

hello.description: The HELO/EHLO name to present to the server.

show_rate.description: Display rate instead of transaction delays (-r).

use_custom_file.description: If true, use -f (file) instead of -s (size) for message source.

custom_file_path.description: Path to an email file (message/rfc822) to send. Used if use_custom_file is true.
